body:
Maintainer request from #1452 ("We should be able to load DXF file to do profile cuts on.").

Depends on #1860 and #1861.

## Goal
Store DXF drawings as `Sketch` entities in `camcraft-app`, persist them in `.camproj`, add the undoable `ImportDxf` command, and expose `import_dxf` on MCP and scripting.

## Scope
- Add a `Sketch` component to `crates/app/src/schema.rs` and register it in `register_schema`. Keep `Sketch` separate from `Facets` so 3D solid tools never treat a 2D drawing as a zero-triangle mesh.
- Store normalized 2D primitives, layer names, chaining tolerance, chained loops/runs from #1861, source DXF units, and import summary counts on `Sketch`. Place the entity on the XY plane with `Location` (`pos`, `rot`) and setup alignment support (`crates/app/src/setup_align.rs`).
- Add `EntityKind::Sketch` to `crates/app/src/project/file.rs` and an optional `sketch` field on `EntityDto` (`crates/app/src/project/entity.rs`). Bump `PROJECT_VERSION` cleanly in `crates/app/src/project/apply.rs` so existing project files load unchanged.
- Implement `ImportDxf::new(path, unit_override)` in `crates/app/src/commands/` following `ImportModel` (`crates/app/src/commands/import_model.rs`). Validate input before mutating `History`. Return a typed missing-units error when `$INSUNITS` is absent or unitless (`0`) and the caller omits `unit_override`.
- Support `DeleteEntity`, `SelectEntity`, `MoveModel` (moving sketch placement), undo, and redo cleanly for `Sketch` entities.
- Expose `import_dxf` in `crates/app/src/mcp/tools.rs` (`get_job` sketch summary included) and `cam.importDxf` in `crates/app/src/script/api.rs` with optional `units` (`"mm"` or `"in"`), optional `join_tol`, and named refusal when units are missing. Return unit and skip counts in the reply.

## Done means
`ImportDxf` creates a `Sketch` entity placed on XY with layer, chain, unit, and skip metadata; missing `$INSUNITS` returns a typed missing-units error unless `unit_override` is given; undo/redo, move, delete, and `.camproj` save/reload round-trip cleanly; MCP `import_dxf` loads DXF drawings headlessly and states units and skipped counts.

Part of #1452
